Reads the points, lines and polygons of an ASCII DXF file of a CAD into three vectors.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** IO, DXF, CAD, Feature, Vector, Reading<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.DxfConverter`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file |  |  | The dxf file. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code defining the coordinate reference system, composed by authority and code number (ex. EPSG:3003). Applied if there is no prj file next to the dxf. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pointsVector` | output file |  | The output point vector. |
| `lineVector` | output file |  | The output lines vector. |
| `polygonVector` | output file |  | The output polygons vector. |
